Theme

Latin word

prīnceps

prīnceps, prīncipis m.

noun, third declension

the emperor, the first citizen; the leading man; in the plural, the leaders of a people; a ruling prince

    also used · classical · Tac. Ann. 1.1: nōmine prīncipis; Tac. Agr. 42.5; Traupman 179

  • prince

    also used · Renaissance · M-O s.v. prince; Levi–Bini p. 4

  • urbs prīnceps: capital

    modern

    modern
